definition: the quality of being or the state that makes, one distinct, superior.
example_en: His superiority was clearly seen by the villagers.

definition: (pl.) both the flanks (of a person).
example_en: From running, both his flanks began to ache.

definition: the state of being convinced (completely).
example_en: From his words, I became completely convinced.

definition: the plant Urginia indica (= Scilla indica) of Liliaceae family.
example_en: The wild urginia plant grew at the foot of that hill.

definition: the chief of an army.
example_en: The army chief gathered his troops together.

definition: the quality of a habitual annoyer or inflicter.
example_en: All the villagers criticized his quality of habitual annoying.

definition: a full-sleeved upper garment worn by men.
example_en: He wore a full-sleeved upper garment for the wedding.

definition: a strong, powerful man.
example_en: That powerful man defeated everyone in wrestling.

definition: a semi-human.
example_en: A semi-human character appears in the story.

definition: the tree Terminalia paniculata of Combretaceae family.
example: ಅರಣ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮರವ ಮರವ ಮರವು ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large Terminalia paniculata tree had grown in the forest.

definition: an irrational, excessive, and persistent fear of some particular thing or situation; any phobia.
example_en: A phobia of heights troubles him.

definition: to commend the worth of; to admire; to praise; to laud.
example_en: The disciples praised the teacher.

definition: the fact or state of going toward the same point; convergence; concurrence.
example: ಎಲ್ಲ ನದಿಗಳ ಏಕಾಭಿಮುಖತೆ ಸಮುದ್ರದ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: All rivers have convergence toward the sea.

definition: a subject or a matter for consideration, other than the one referred to or being considered at present.
example_en: The chairman said that another matter should not be discussed in the meeting.

definition: a person authorised and empowered to carry out something on behalf of another; an agent.
example: ಆ ಮುತಾಲಿಕ ಒಡೆಯನ ಪರವಾಗಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: That agent conducted the business on behalf of the owner.

definition: love - a) strong affection for another arising out of kinship or personal ties; b) attraction based on sexual desire; c) affection based on admiration, benevolence or common interests (as love for one's old schoolmates).
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಶಾಲಾ ಗೆಳೆಯರ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕೂರ್ಪು ಇನ್ನೂ ಇದೆ.
example_en: He still has love for his old schoolmates.

definition: the act of praising, extolling or flattering.
example: ಆ ಶಿಲ್ಪಿಯ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಜನರ ಪೊಗರ್ತೆ ಹರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The people's praise flowed for that sculptor's work.

definition: the tree Syzygium hemisphaericum (= Eugenia hemisphaerica) of Myrtaceaefamily.
example_en: The children are playing under the Syzygium hemisphaericum tree.

definition: to come near; to approach.
example_en: I waved for him to come near me.

definition: a person appointed to govern a dependency, province, town, fort, etc. ; a governor.
example_en: The governor had taken charge of that state's administration.

definition: to make a snorting or grunting sound in breathing during sleep; to snore.
example: ಅವನು ರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೊರೆದು ಮನೆಯವರಿಗೆ ತೊಂದರೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He snored at night and disturbed the people in the house.

definition: the inner side of a fort, barrier etc.
example_en: The soldiers stood guard on the inner side of the fort.

definition: of or belonging to a region; regional.
example_en: This is a regional problem.

definition: impure carbonate of soda; hydrated sodium carbonate; natron.
example_en: They mixed a little washing soda so that the idli would turn soft.

definition: a wall running across the length of a house.
example_en: They have built a cross wall in the middle of the house.

definition: sodium chloride; common salt, a food-grade salt.
example: ಅವಳು ಸಾರಿಗೆ ಅಡಿಗೆಯುಪ್ಪು ಬೆರೆಸಿ ರುಚಿ ನೋಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She mixed common salt into the curry and tasted it.

definition: a displacing or being displaced; displacement.
example: ಈ ಕಚೇರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಫೈಲುಗಳ ಸ್ಥಲಪಲ್ಲಟದಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ ತಡವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Work was delayed in this office due to the displacement of files.

definition: to be damaged or injured in such a way as to become useless, valueless, etc., esp. to decay (as food); to spoil (oneself).
example_en: The rice soaked in the rain spoiled quickly.

definition: sweet sounding, honeyed talk or words.
example: ಅವಳ ಪೊದರ್ಕೊದಳ್ ಮಾತು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: Her honeyed words attracted everyone's mind.

definition: the act of tickling.
example_en: Father played with the baby by tickling it.

definition: being under (another's) control; subjugated.
example_en: That kingdom was subjugated under the great empire.

definition: on or beside the length of; over or throughout the length of; along.
example_en: Trees have been planted along the road.

definition: to become soft, tender.
example_en: The butter became soft in the heat.

definition: heavy or heavier.
example_en: That stone box was heavier than the gold.

definition: of or having to do with the phenomenal world, as diff. from spiritual one.
example_en: His talk was limited to worldly matters.

definition: a woman who is characterised by evil, immoral, unchaste, sinful or irreligious qualities.
example_en: The villagers kept that unchaste woman away.

definition: (temperature) to rise.
example_en: The temperature rises at noon.

definition: to disclose to and discuss with another one's private feelings, affairs, etc.; to confide to.
example_en: She confided her sorrow to her friend.

definition: the pavilion in front of a temple.
example_en: The pillars of the temple pavilion were carved from stone.

definition: relating to education; educational.
example_en: The government implemented educational reforms.

definition: a game of chance for high stakes played with dice; gambling.
example: ಆತ ಜೂಜಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕ್ಷವತಿ ಆಡಿ ಹಣ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He played gambling with dice and lost money.

definition: a large number of people gathered closely together; a crowd.
example_en: A large crowd had gathered at the fair.

definition: the creeper Piper chaba (= P. officinarum) of Piperaceae family.
example_en: The creeper kāḍu meṇasu is used for medicine.

definition: a sub-clan of brāhmaṇas.
example: ಸಂಕೇತಿ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರು ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಉಪಭಾಷೆ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The Sankethi brahmins speak their own dialect.

definition: the leaf of the beal tree (Aegle marmelos).
example_en: He brought the beal leaf and placed it for worship.

definition: a disloyal, faithless wicked, treacherous person.
example_en: No one should believe the words of that treacherous person.

definition: a shop where toddy is sold.
example_en: There is a toddy shop near the village.

definition: a form of protest, exhibiting one's firm resoluteness by sitting at a place without moving from that place, till one's demand is met.
example: ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು ಬೈಠಕ್‍ಮುಷ್ಕರ ಮಾಡಿ ತಮ್ಮ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಈಡೇರಿಸಲು ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The workers staged a sit-in protest and demanded that their demand be met.

definition: darkness occuring during daytime.
example_en: Darkness in daytime had enveloped that forest.

definition: skill in using one's hands; dexterity of the hand.
example_en: That craftsman's dexterity of hand amazed everyone.

definition: the act of imitating, impersonating by mimicking another or others for purpose of entertainment; mimicry; impersonation.
example_en: His mimicry made the audience laugh.

definition: an ignoble, contemptible woman.
example_en: That contemptible woman respected no one.

definition: a paper to write on.
example_en: He wrote a letter on the paper.

definition: a principle, regulation or a restraint, which restricts the conduct, procedure or manner; a rule; restriction.
example_en: Everyone must follow the organization's rules.

definition: to restrain oneself; to keep oneself under control.
example_en: When angry, he kept himself under control and did not speak.

definition: the castor plant Jatropha multifida of Euphorbiaceae family; coral plant.
example_en: A coral plant had grown along the garden fence.

definition: to talk to, convey a message, secretely.
example_en: The messenger conveyed the secret message to the king.

definition: the act or an instance of invading enemy army, by making surprise raids, esp. behind the lines, by member of a small defensive force of irregular soldiers, usu. volunteers; guerrilla warfare.
example_en: The soldiers defeated the enemies through guerrilla warfare.

definition: the act or an instance of swallowing; a devouring.
example: ಅವನು ಒಂದೇ ನಿಗಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದ ಅನ್ನವನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಮುಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He finished all the remaining rice in a single swallow.

definition: a harmless, moderate-sized, tropical lizard, Iguana tuberculata of Iguanidae family, having a row of spines from neck to tail, which is known for its grip and used in scaling forts, and which feeds on insects or vegetation; the common iguana.
example_en: The iguana was basking in the sun on the rock.

definition: a male cat; (2) (fig.) a big, slow, fat person; a lubber.
example_en: A male cat was lying in the sun on the street.

definition: the quality of being pretty; prettiness.
example_en: That girl's prettiness attracted everyone.

definition: to become thoroughly dry.
example_en: The clothes dried in the sun became thoroughly dry.

definition: (cattle) (said of cattle) to feed on growing grass, etc.; to graze.
example: ಗೋವುಗಳು ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಸಿರು ಹುಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಮೇಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The cows were grazing on the green grass on the hill.

definition: the military unit of a nation charged with carrying out military operations in the air; air force.
example_en: The fighter planes took off from the air force base.

definition: holding; bearing.
example_en: This pillar is bearing the roof.

definition: a seat made of rattan sticks.
example_en: The grandmother sat on the rattan seat and rested.

definition: the act of offering resistance to; opposition.
example_en: The people showed opposition to the new rule.

definition: to fasten or catch with a loop or loops.
example_en: He fastened the cow with a loop of rope and tied it.

definition: a cruel, inhuman order, direction, injunction or command.
example: ಆ ರಾಜ ಕ್ರೂರಾಜ್ಞೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊರಡಿಸಿ ಜನರನ್ನು ಬೆದರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That king issued a cruel order and frightened the people.

definition: Śiva, the Great or Supreme Lord.
example_en: The devotees went to Maheshwara's temple.

definition: the time that has gone by; past.
example: ಮೊನೆಯೇಡಿನ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳನ್ನು ಮರೆತು ಅವರು ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಿದರು.
example_en: Forgetting the hardships of the past, they moved forward.

definition: a compulsory payment levied on income, proiperty value, sale value, etc.; a tax.
example_en: One must pay tax to the government every year.

definition: to protect, guard.
example_en: He carefully guarded his property.

definition: the unburnt part of a fire-brand.
example_en: One unburnt part of the fire-brand remained in the stove.

definition: the act or manner of walking, moving; a particular way of walking, running, etc. (of a person or animal); gait; walk.
example: ಅವನ ಗತಿಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಿದರೆ ಅವನು ಸೈನಿಕನೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Looking at his gait, one can tell he is a soldier.

definition: the level of the ground.
example_en: They checked the level of the ground before building the house.

definition: pleasing light.
example_en: The pleasing light of dawn shone on the water of the pond.

definition: any valuable thing.
example_en: He carefully kept every valuable thing.

definition: anything that is in extreme degree.
example_en: He was confined to bed due to the extreme intensity of the fever.

definition: the act of bathing.
example: ನದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀಣ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಅವನು ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: After finishing his bathing in the river, he went to the temple.

definition: a thing that is very beautiful.
example_en: That sculpture was truly a thing of great beauty.

definition: a small package; a packet.
example_en: He put the small packet of medicine into the bag.

definition: an ass.
example_en: The ass carried the load on its back.

definition: an ornament worn around the ankle; an anklet.
example_en: Her anklet was made of gold.

definition: the dark blue colour.
example: ಆಕಾಶದ ಕನ್ನೀಲಿ ಬಣ್ಣ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಆಹ್ಲಾದ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The dark blue colour of the sky gave pleasure to the mind.

definition: to help an animal in delivering its young one.
example: ಆ ಆಡನ್ನು ಈನಿಸಲು ರೈತ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer helped that goat deliver its young one.

definition: the state of lying upside down or bottom portion up.
example_en: The vessel had fallen upside down on the ground.

definition: a small shop that sells commodities in small quantities; a retail shop.
example_en: There was a small retail shop on that street.

definition: a foretelling, prophecy predicted by the people of a community (buḍubuḍike) who pursue the profession by some supposed superhuman guidance.
example_en: The wandering fortune-teller uttered a prophecy in front of the house.

definition: to lose patience; to become impatient.
example_en: After waiting and waiting, he lost patience.

definition: a man who is hereditarily working as a slave.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಬೞಿದೊೞ್ತು ತಲೆಮಾರುಗಳಿಂದ ಸೇವೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: In that house, a hereditary slave had been serving for generations.

definition: to recognise (something) by (its) sign.
example_en: They recognised him by his footprint.

definition: to send forth (liquid, light, heat, sound, particles, etc.); to discharge; to emit.
example_en: That machine was emitting poisonous smoke.

definition: wealth; riches.
example_en: Wealth earned through hard work remains permanently.

definition: a sort of musical instrument, chiefly used by snake-charmers; a kind of fife.
example_en: The snake-charmer blew the fife and made the snake dance.

definition: the divine power that controls the entire phenomenal world.
example_en: Everyone believed in the divine power that controls the world.

definition: to call, invite affectionately or with concern.
example_en: The grandmother called her grandson affectionately.

definition: a kind of wading bird with a long neck, long legs, and a long, tapered bill, living along marshes and river banks; a kind of heron.
example: ಕೊಚವಕ್ಕಿ ಸರೋವರದ ಬಳಿಯ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The heron was sitting on a tree near the lake.

definition: a worn, torn, tattered clothes; rags.
example_en: The poor man walked in the street wearing tattered rags.

definition: a village or town.
example_en: This town is a very ancient one.

definition: a string of gold or silver for wearing round the neck; a necklace.
example_en: Grandmother had carefully kept the silver necklace.

definition: an interjection used to point out an object which is relatively near.
example_en: Look here, he is over there.

definition: a metal plate nailed to the hooves of oxen, horses, etc. for protection; a shoe.
example_en: They had a shoe nailed to the ox's leg.

definition: facing east; turned towards east.
example_en: The temple tower is facing east.

definition: an ugly-looking person.
example: ಊರಿನವರು ಅವನನ್ನು ಚೆಂದಗೇಡಿ ಎಂದು ಗೇಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers mocked him as an ugly-looking person.

definition: a man who do not express his emotions, intentions to others.
example_en: The man who hides his emotions told no one his feelings.

definition: to pose or put (something) forward or in front of.
example_en: They put forward their argument.

definition: the distance from the hindmost point to the foremost point.
example_en: This cart's length from front to back is very long.

definition: a spider.
example_en: A spider had woven a web in the corner of the wall.

definition: the quality of wicked fellow; wickedness.
example_en: His wickedness was finally exposed.

definition: a wise, learned man.
example: ಆ ಸುಜ್ಞ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That wise man used to give good advice to everyone.

definition: a pillar to lean on or something is leaning on.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ನೆರ್ಮುಗಂಭ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a leaning pillar in that old temple.

definition: a man with a grinning face; a man who habitually grins.
example_en: The grinning man was always laughing when he spoke.

definition: hair growing on the body.
example: ಆತನ ಕೈಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ರೊಣೆ ದಟ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The hair on his hand had grown thick.

definition: to rest (oneself) for a shortwhile.
example_en: Come, let us rest for a while during the journey.

definition: the total of different amount or values.
example_en: The accountant prepared the total of all the expenses.

definition: the blade of a sword.
example_en: The blade of the sword was very sharp.

definition: a little house of the crudest kind with a thatched roof; a hut.
example_en: That thatched hut was shaking in the wind.

definition: to change (something) so that it fits, corresponds or conforms; to adjust.
example_en: The cook adjusted the curry to suit the taste.

definition: a kind of medicinal preparation, made using curds.
example_en: The doctor told him to apply the curd-based medicinal oil to the wound.

definition: collectively, fine arts.
example_en: A display of the collective fine arts took place in this town.

definition: resounded resonantly.
example_en: The bell's sound resounded resonantly in the temple.

definition: to march with an army to attack.
example_en: The commander marched with an army to attack the enemies.

definition: (rhet.) a woman who vies with the heroine or the main female character of a drama, epic, etc.
example_en: In the drama, the rival heroine's role was very powerful.

definition: the fact or feeling of being displeased; dissatisfaction, an unfavourable opinion; dislike; disapproval, disfavour.
example: ಅವನ ನಡತೆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಗುರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಅವಕೃಪೆ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The teacher felt displeasure about his behaviour.

definition: a secret, usu. evil, project or scheme; conspiracy; a plot.
example_en: The police exposed that conspiracy.

definition: the time of day from noon to evening; the afternoon.
example_en: In the afternoon, the sun's heat reduces a little.

definition: the fact of being used for long; usage.
example: ಈ ಸಾಧನದ ಪಳಕದಿಂದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಅನುಭವ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: Good experience came to him from long usage of this tool.

definition: an interrogating or being interrogated; examination; enquiring.
example_en: The police interrogated him.

definition: a stone-pillar.
example_en: The stone-pillar still stands in the old temple.

definition: a strong, muscular hand.
example_en: It hurt when he gripped me with his strong hand.

definition: rumours that is baseless but spread widely.
example_en: A baseless rumour spread quickly in the village.

definition: (masc.) one who winks.
example_en: That winking man was giving signals to everyone.

definition: a bird, akin to crow, resembling the pheasant; a crow-pheasant.
example_en: The crow-pheasant eats insects in the field.

definition: a recurrent disorder of the nervous system, characterised either by mild, episodic loss of attention or sleepiness or by severe convulsions with loss of consciousness, accompanied by convulsions, physical dysfunction, etc.; epilepsy.
example_en: He had an epileptic fit and his body convulsed.

definition: a specialist or expert in grammar; a grammarian.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣಜ್ಞ ಕನ್ನಡ ವ್ಯಾಕರಣವನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬಲ್ಲನು.
example_en: That grammarian knows Kannada grammar very well.

definition: either of the two feathered forelimbs of a bird, either or not fully developed for flying, for flight, balance in running, for swimming, etc.; a wing.
example: ಹಕ್ಕಿ ತನ್ನ ಎಱಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಡಿದು ಆಕಾಶಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾರಿತು.
example_en: The bird flapped its wings and flew into the sky.

definition: he who has not bathed.
example_en: He who had not bathed was not allowed to take part in the worship.

definition: an artificial organ, with, without or partial ability to function, replacing the corresponding organ of the body amputated by surgery.
example: ಅಪಘಾತದ ನಂತರ ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕೃತಕ ಅಂಗವನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: After the accident the doctors fitted him with an artificial organ.

definition: the quality of being bright; brightness; lustre.
example: ನವಿಲಿನ ಗರಿಯ ಪೊಗರ್ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಕಣ್ಣನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The brightness of the peacock feather drew everyone's eyes.

definition: the vine Piper betle of Piperaceae family; betel leaf vine.
example_en: The betel leaf vine has spread and grown in the courtyard.

definition: the act of cutting, dividing with a saw.
example_en: The worker split the log by sawing it apart.

definition: extraordinary whiteness.
example_en: The extraordinary whiteness of that flower captivated the onlookers.

definition: (pl.) people seeking, requesting, begging for, something.
example_en: People seeking alms had gathered in front of the temple.

definition: the quality or the fact of being marked with different colours; variegation.
example_en: The variegation of the peacock feather fascinated him.

definition: a rich, wealthy man.
example_en: The wealthy man generously donated to the poor.

definition: the plant Phaseolus adenanthus of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The kadu-hesaru creeper had spread at the edge of the forest.

definition: to make, take a vow, promise by a vow, as to a god or saint; to vow.
example_en: The farmer made a vow to god for rain.

definition: to forcibly acquire, take possession some thing as a security.
example_en: They forcibly took the debtor's gold as security.

definition: a condition that is causing irritation or annoyance; irritation; an uncomfortable situation.
example_en: The noise of the bus caused irritation all night.

definition: original; natural; not artificial.
example: ಅವನ ನಗು ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಾಕೃತ ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಜವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His smile was very natural and unaffected.

definition: intense light that overpowers or dims the vision; dazzling light.
example_en: The dazzling light of the noon sun struck the eyes.

definition: a honey-bee.
example_en: The honey-bee buzzed over the flowers of the garden.

definition: a nonhuman primate mammal esp. any of the smaller longer-tailed primates; a monkey.
example_en: The monkey jumped from tree to tree in the forest.

definition: an installation of an idol in the prescribed religious manner.
example_en: The installation of Ganapati's idol took place according to scripture.

definition: the act of scattering in drops; a sprinkling.
example: ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಣ್ಣದ ದಳಿ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The sprinkling of colour on the cloth looked beautiful.

definition: having, covered with hair; hairy.
example_en: That animal's body was completely covered with hair.

definition: vision - a) the act or power of seeing with the eye; sense of sight; b) the object seen; c) something supposedly seen by other than normal sight; something perceived in a dream, trance, etc. or supernaturally revealed, as to a prophet; d) the experience of having such a perception or revelation; e) the act or power of anticipating that which will or may happen; anticipation.
example_en: The saint had a divine vision.

definition: to take a bath; to bathe oneself.
example_en: He got up in the morning and bathed.

definition: an impudent and clever harlot.
example: ಆ ಗಂಡುಸೂಳೆ ತನ್ನ ಜಾಣ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That impudent, clever harlot deceived everyone with her cunning.

definition: energetic activity; stir; bustle; ferment.
example: ಹಬ್ಬಕ್ಕೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ತುಂಬಾ ಹೌಸು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: Everyone in the house had a lot of bustle for the festival.

definition: a saying quoted from (holy) scriptures as Bhagavadgīta or similar ones.
example: ಗುರುವು ಭಗವದ್ಗೀತೆಯ ಗೀತವಾತನ್ನು ಹೇಳಿ ಶಿಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಬೋಧಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The teacher quoted a scriptural saying from the Bhagavad Gita and taught it to his disciples.

definition: the state of being incomplete; incompleteness.
example_en: Incompleteness is evident in that work.

definition: the act, business or profession of a procurer or procuress.
example_en: He had taken up procuring as his profession.

definition: a pulling up by roots; uprooting.
example_en: They cleaned the field by uprooting the weeds.

definition: a preparing or being prepared; preparation.
example_en: The preparations needed for the wedding were finished beforehand.

definition: cessation of life; death.
example: ಆತನ ಕಾಲಕರ್ಮದಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಶೋಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿತು.
example_en: Due to his death, the whole family was plunged into grief.

definition: the totality of animate and inanimate things.
example_en: In this world, the totality of animate and inanimate things exists.

definition: a way, path, road.
example_en: That path passes over the hill.

definition: to start doing, acting, going, etc.; to get under way; to begin; to initiate.
example_en: He began the new job on Monday.

definition: increased by the same quantity or number; doubled.
example_en: The company's profit was doubled.

definition: a kind of bird, Turdus ginginianus.
example: ಆಟಿ ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The Turdus ginginianus bird was sitting on the branch of a tree.

definition: to move forward by or as by crawling.
example: ಹಾವು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ತೀಕುತ್ತಾ ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಿತು.
example_en: The snake crawled forward on the ground.

definition: name of a state, now officially and popularly known as Mahārāṣṭra, in Western India, having Mumbai as its capital.
example_en: Mumbai is the capital of the Maratha region.

definition: any three-sided or three-cornered figure, area, object, part, etc. ; a triangle.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಹಲಗೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೋಣತ್ರಯವನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಿ ತೋರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher drew and showed a triangle on the board.

definition: Viṣṇu, in whom Lakṣmi resides.
example_en: The devotees worshipped Śrīnīḍa (Viṣṇu) with devotion.

definition: any fragrant substance, prepared from the extracts of flowers of made synthetically, used as a body-perfume.
example_en: She applied a fragrant body-perfume on herself.

definition: the rear end of an arrow that is feathered.
example_en: The feathered rear end of the arrow was broken.

definition: that can be or is fit to be spoken.
example_en: This is a subject fit to be spoken about in the assembly.

definition: a man who is born as a partial incarnation of a divine power ( of a god).
example: ಪುರಾಣದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಆತನನ್ನು ದೈವದ ಅಂಶಜ ಎಂದು ನಂಬುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: According to the legend, he is believed to be a partial incarnation of a god.

definition: a kind of musical pipe.
example_en: The sound of the musical pipe was heard during the festival.

definition: a being that has a tail.
example_en: That animal is a tailed creature.

definition: (all) at once; (several things or everything happening) simultaneously.
example_en: Everyone stood up all at once.

definition: the quality of being innocent; innocence.
example_en: Everyone was delighted seeing the child's innocence.

definition: to become physically weak or weaker; to be weakened.
example_en: The workers became physically weakened from continuous labor.

definition: polluted, dirty water.
example: ಆ ಕೊಳದ ತೋಯಿಲದಿಂದ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ವಾಸನೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A foul smell was coming from the polluted water of that pond.

definition: a woman as related to a man to whom she is married; a wife.
example_en: His wife was eating in the kitchen.

definition: a man who has won; he who is successful esp. through praiseworthy ability and hard work.
example_en: The successful man who worked hard earned respect.

definition: a single-reed, clarinet-like wind instrument with a wooden or metal tube, played by means of holes.
example_en: The sound of the clarinet-like wind instrument was heard far away.

definition: that which is not crooked, bent, angled, etc.; a straight thing.
example: ಆ ಕೋಲಿನ ನೇರಿತು ನೋಡಿ ಅವನು ಮೆಚ್ಚಿದನು.
example_en: He admired seeing the straightness of that stick.

definition: an excellent song.
example_en: The artist sang an excellent song at the gathering.

definition: the cardinal number thirteen; 13.
example_en: There were thirteen houses on that list.

definition: a wound on the body; an inury to the body.
example: ಬಿದ್ದ ಕಾರಣ ಅವನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೆಯ್ಗಡಿತ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A wound occurred on his arm because he fell.

definition: this much.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಯಲು ಈಪಾಟಿ ಸಮಯ ಸಾಕು.
example_en: This much time is enough to finish this work.

definition: the pair of feet (of a person).
example_en: His pair of feet was very small.

definition: a large, smooth, dark surface of slate or other material on which to write or draw with chalk; a blackboard.
example_en: The lesson was written on the classroom's blackboard.

definition: at all times; on all occasions; always.
example_en: He always speaks the truth.

definition: to be peaceful or regain peace, calmness.
example_en: After the war, that land regained peace.

definition: to immigrate, en masse , from the normal place of living, to settle in another, permanently or for a relatively longer period (esp. necessitated by famine, disaster, etc. or by threat or coercion).
example_en: Fearing injustice, the people migrated en masse to the town.

definition: to cause to hear; to narrate; to tell.
example_en: The teacher narrated the story to the students.

definition: to keep from happening; to ward off; to avert.
example_en: The officer averted the danger before it could happen.

definition: to cause to be caught, arrested.
example_en: The police had the thief caught.

definition: a kind of fever.
example_en: The child suffered from that fever.

definition: air.
example_en: The air on the hill was cool.

definition: the cardinal number eighty-four.
example_en: There are eighty-four houses in that village.

definition: having no protection; not secure; insecure.
example_en: That area was insecure and the people were frightened.

definition: any of a genus (Ocimum) of fragrant plants of the mint family, esp. a white-flowered garden herb (Ocimum sanctum which is religiously regarded as a goddess).
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ತೊಳಂಚಿ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂಜೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: Grandmother uses holy basil leaves for worship every day.

definition: agreement in feeling, action, ideas, interests, etc.; peaceable or friendly relations; harmony; an association marked by compatibility.
example: ಎರಡು ಗ್ರಾಮಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹೊದ್ದಿಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was years of harmony between the two villages.

definition: to include, contain (without oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This contract includes all the workers.

definition: the tree Grewia vilosa of Tiliaceae family;round leaved Indian linden.
example_en: The leaves of the murige tree become fodder for the cattle.

definition: a shrub, herb, creeper or young tree; gen. characterised by the ability to carry on photosynthesis in its cells which contain chloroplasts and have cellulose in the cell wall.
example: ಮನೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಗಿಡ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A small shrub has grown in front of the house.

definition: grain stored in a granary under the ground.
example_en: In the village they had stored paddy in the underground granary.

definition: tender attachment; fondness; affection; love.
example: ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಮಗುವಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಪಾರ ತಕ್ಕೂರ್ಮೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The mother had immense tender affection for her child.

definition: want of power to remember perfectly.
example_en: As she grew old, the grandmother suffered from poor memory.

definition: to carry on; to go further or forward.
example: ಈ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯನ್ನು ಮುಂದೆ ಒಯ್ಯಲು ಅವನು ವಹಿಸಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He took on the responsibility to carry it forward.

definition: a secret path.
example_en: He knew the secret path through the forest well.

definition: to appear; to come to be seen.
example_en: The moon appeared from behind the clouds.

definition: sexual sport and intercourse.
example_en: The poet described the lovers' sexual sport.

definition: a kind of scorpion.
example_en: The white scorpion lives in the hollow of a dry tree.

definition: the state of being carried away with joy, love, etc.; ecstasy; rapture.
example: ತನ್ನ ಮಗನ ಯಶಸ್ಸು ಕೇಳಿ ಆಕೆ ಅಮಕ್ಕಳದಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದಳು.
example_en: On hearing of her son's success, she was filled with ecstasy.

definition: a large pond.
example: ಊರ ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮಾಗುಂಡ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a large pond outside the village.

definition: (dial.) one who, without concern, joins the marriage team.
example: ಅಡನಿಬ್ಬಣಿಗನು ಯಾವುದೇ ಚಿಂತೆಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಮದುವೆ ಮೆರವಣಿಗೆಗೆ ಸೇರಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: The uninvited guest joined the wedding procession without any concern.

definition: to be totally confused; to be bewildered.
example_en: Seeing the exam questions, the student was totally bewildered.

definition: a narrow, deep stretch of land lying between hills or mountains; a valley.
example_en: A river flowed in the valley between the hills.

definition: (growth of someone or something) to be checked; to have stunted growth.
example_en: Due to the lack of water, the plant's growth was stunted.

definition: the act or an instance of falling from a higher place; a fall.
example_en: He was injured in the fall from the rock.

definition: dim light.
example_en: A dim light was seen in the distance.

definition: a farm land at a lower level.
example_en: They grow paddy in the lower-lying farmland.

definition: an excellent brāhmaṇa.
example_en: The excellent brahmana performed the sacrifice according to the rules.

definition: the condition or quality of being not available; absence; non-existence.
example_en: The absence of a hospital in the village troubled the people.

definition: to cause boredom, antipathy, repugnance to (another).
example_en: His repeated questions caused me boredom.

definition: erection of hairs on the body from joy.
example: ಆ ದೃಶ್ಯ ಕಂಡು ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ಲೋಮಹರ್ಷಣ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing that sight, the audience felt their hair stand on end with joy.

definition: the act of hiding; a concealing.
example_en: His concealing was eventually revealed.

definition: a regular and repeated circuit of (an area, town, camp, etc.) in guarding; a patrolling.
example_en: The troops carried out a patrol around the camp.

definition: a movement in art, literature, and drama, characterised by distortion of reality and the use of symbols, stylization, etc. to give objective expression to inner experience; expressionism.
example: ಆ ಚಿತ್ರಕಾರ ಅಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿವಾದದ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿತ್ರ ಬಿಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That painter drew the picture in the style of expressionism.

definition: to swing or sway one's hand backward and forward or from one side to another.
example_en: She called her friends from a distance, waving her hand.

definition: something that restricts; a restrictive or limiting condition or regulation; a restriction.
example_en: There were many restrictive conditions in the agreement.

definition: a mature crop (that is ready for harvesting).
example_en: The mature crop in the field was ready for harvesting.

definition: an order or law of the government, that forbids, prohibits anything; a prohibitory order.
example_en: The district collector issued a prohibitory order and stopped the gathering.

definition: a wishing well (to another or to a cause); well-wishing.
example_en: I do not need your well-wishing.

definition: an elder sister.
example_en: My elder sister goes to school every day.

definition: a percussion instrument consisting of a round, shallow vessel with a membrane stretched over its wide mouth, played by beating with sticks.
example_en: They were beating the dundumi drum in the procession.

definition: the need for, and the discomfort, pain caused by a need for, food; hunger.
example: ಇಡೀ ದಿನ ಊಟ ಸಿಗದೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪಸು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: His hunger increased as he had no food the whole day.

definition: a studying, esp. the vedas, on one's own (without taking help or guidance from others).
example: ಆ ಬಾಲಕ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಸ್ವಾಧ್ಯಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That boy used to do self-study of the vedas every morning.

definition: an exempting of a land from payment of tax.
example_en: This land has received a jodi tax exemption.

definition: a mark that mars the appearance, as a stain, spot, scar, etc.; a mark left on the skin or other tissue after a wound, burn, ulcer, pustule, lesion, etc. has healed; cicatrix ; a scar.
example: ಗಾಯ ಗುಣವಾದ ಮೇಲೆಯೂ ಚರ್ಮದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಳಂಕ ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Even after the wound healed, a scar remained on the skin.

definition: the quality or condition of being complet in every way.
example_en: The completeness of this project pleased everyone.

definition: a taking of one's chief meal of the day.
example: ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: After finishing work, everyone had their meal together.

definition: curdled milk; curds.
example_en: Fresh curds are available in the shop.

definition: a survey carried out from an aircraft; an aerial survey.
example: ಸೇನೆಯು ಗಡಿ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಅಂತರಿಕ್ಷ ಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆ ನಡೆಸಿತು.
example_en: The army carried out an aerial survey of the border area.

definition: the fact or condition of (one's head) being shaven.
example_en: Everyone was surprised to see his shaven head.

definition: a woman or girl who engages in promiscuous sexual activity for payment or for mere enjoyment; a prostitute; a harlot; a courtesan.
example: ಪಟ್ಟಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಕುಲಟಾವಧು ಬೀದಿಯ ಮೂಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: In the town, that courtesan lived at the corner of the street.

definition: the early state of youth, characterised by immaturity, impetuosity, vigour, etc.
example_en: In his early youth, there was a lot of enthusiasm.

definition: a fighting with the fists.
example_en: Two boys had a fistfight on the street.

definition: sodium nitrate.
example_en: They used sodium nitrate to wash clothes.

definition: a frying pan or a cooking vessel.
example_en: In the kitchen, she was making dosa on the frying pan.

definition: the edible, starchy, tuberous root of Amorphophallus campanulatus (araceae family); elephant yam.
example_en: They roasted and ate the elephant yam.

definition: the large, evergreen tree Poeciloneuron indicum of Guttiferae family, with darkish red wood, used for building construction, making railway sleepers, electric poles, etc.
example_en: The ballagi tree is used for making electric poles.

definition: to match for; to compete (with another) successfully.
example_en: No one could match him in the race.

definition: a ruler with absolute power and authority; an absolute dictator.
example: ಆ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಏಕಾಧಿಪತಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಅಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನೂ ತನ್ನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The absolute ruler of that kingdom held all power in his own hands.

definition: (a hot object) to heat or burn by coming into physical contact.
example_en: The hot iron touched the hand and burnt it.

definition: the quality or fact of being temporary, fleeting, ephemeral or not enduring; transitoriness.
example_en: Realizing the transitoriness of life, he became a sanyasi.

definition: a perfectly round pearl.
example_en: That perfectly round pearl was glittering in the light.

definition: the act of consulting, exchanging of views, etc. on some subject; consultation.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇಂದು ಸಮಾಳೋಚನ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A consultation on this matter was held today.

definition: a seizing, grasping; a holding together.
example_en: He collects old coins.

definition: to beat, strike repeatedly or pound.
example_en: He pounded hard on the door.

definition: a multitude of students.
example_en: A multitude of students gathered in the hall and listened to the lecture.

definition: knowledge as a means.
example_en: Knowledge as a means showed the seeker the truth.

definition: to wander or roam about.
example_en: The orphan child was wandering about without shelter.

definition: a place where the funds of the government, of a corporation or the like are deposited, kept, and disbursed; a treasury.
example_en: The gold has been kept in the government treasury.

definition: the animal Iguana tuberculata, of a large family (Iguanidae) of tree or ground, lizards; (a harmless, moderate-size, tropical lizard that feed on insects or vegetation and have a row of spines from neck to tail, which is known for its grip and used in scaling forts); the common iguana.
example: ನಿಹಾಕೆಯು ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಸೊಳ್ಳೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The iguana sits on the tree and eats insects.

definition: the sound of chuckling.
example_en: Everyone laughed on hearing the child's chuckling sound.

definition: an indication; a sign; a token.
example_en: Those clouds were a sign of rain.

definition: the lower front part of the human body between the chest and thighs; the belly.
example_en: His belly was swollen because he ate too much.

definition: a thin flash of light, of different shapes, in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another; a thin lightening.
example: ತಟಿದ್ವಲ್ಲರಿ ಮೋಡಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಕ್ಷಣಮಾತ್ರ ಕಾಣಿಸಿ ಮಾಯವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The thin lightning appeared for a moment between the clouds and vanished.

definition: a train that runs in a tubular tunnel; a tube-train.
example: ಆ ನಗರದ ಟ್ಯೂಬುರೈಲು ಬಹಳ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That city's tube-train moved very fast.

definition: all that is spoken.
example_en: All that was spoken in the meeting was important to everyone.

definition: name of a celebrated sage.
example: ಭೃಗು ಮುನಿ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪುರಾಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅನೇಕ ಕಥೆಗಳಿವೆ.
example_en: There are many stories in the puranas about the sage Bhrigu.

definition: the quality of being swift; quickness; swiftness.
example_en: The horse's swiftness helped the soldiers in the battle.

definition: praise; commendation.
example_en: The poet received praise from the people.

definition: the mythological mountain Mēru.
example_en: The golden mountain Meru is believed to be the sacred abode of the gods.

definition: to get acquainted with; to have another person introduced to oneself.
example_en: He got acquainted with the newcomers at the meeting.

definition: excessively; intensely; immoderately; inordinately.
example_en: He became excessively angry.

definition: a person who has ideas and is imaginative; a practical visionary.
example: ಆತ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸ್ಪಪ್ನಜೀವಿ, ಹೊಸ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕನಸು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is a visionary who dreams up new plans.

definition: a short-sleeved shirt (worn by men).
example_en: He wore a short-sleeved shirt in summer.

definition: blown or expanded (as a flower).
example_en: The blown flowers in the garden were spreading fragrance.

definition: a stage in a stadium where wrestling takes place; an arena.
example_en: Two wrestlers competed in the wrestling arena.

definition: a clan of muslims originally from Afghanistan.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನೇಕ ಪಠಾನ್ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: Many Pathan families lived in that town.

definition: to do, perform (an action etc.) to carry out; to fulfil.
example_en: He performs the worship with devotion.

definition: to catch up something (that is going or progressing ahead) and go or progress beyond.
example_en: The runner overtook everyone and went ahead.

definition: that which thinks, perceives, feels, etc.; the mind.
example_en: His mind desires only peace.

definition: one who is very caustic in speaking.
example_en: He was known in the village as one very caustic in speech.

definition: to be captured, held, imprisoned.
example_en: The thief was captured by the police.

definition: quickness; swiftness.
example_en: The opponent lost because of the player's swiftness.

definition: one who leads others or goes first; a leader; the principal person.
example_en: The leader of the group walked ahead of everyone.

definition: to put (a sword, dagger, etc.) into a sheath; to sheathe.
example_en: The soldier sheathed his sword and stood.

definition: a light footwear; a slipper.
example_en: Colourful slippers were for sale in the shop.

definition: a small, wrapped bundle; a package; a parcel.
example_en: The postman delivered the parcel to the house.

definition: happening or being published once every three months; trimonthly.
example_en: That research journal is published trimonthly.

definition: the profession of buying and selling of comodities; commerce.

definition: a change, modification, etc. that is to be made beforehand.

definition: a class of syllabic feet, having four syllables in each foot.

example_en: He is my intimate companion and never keeps any secret from me.

definition: the bill of a bird.

definition: air in motion; wind.

definition: the sensation perceived generally by the auditory nerves; sound.

definition: exactly in the same manner; similarly.

definition: to engage in a discussion or argument; to discuss; to debate.

definition: to be puzzled, perplexed completely.

definition: the repeatedly occurring vomitive feeling.

example_en: The Libra sign lies between Virgo and Scorpio.

definition: any decapod crustacean of the suborder Brachyura, having the eyes on short stalks and a short, broad, more or less flattened body, the abdomen being small and folded under the thorax; a crab.
example: ಕಡಲ ದಂಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ನಳ್ಳಿ ಮರಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನುಸುಳಿತು.

definition: not troubled, tortured or restricted.

definition: a person who goes on foot; a walker; a pedestrain.

example_en: That pedestrian walks ten kilometers every day.

definition: the office, status or duties of the chief of a village.

definition: a woman who sweeps or brooms; a sweeper.

example_en: That woman sweeper sweeps the courtyard of the house every day.

definition: unrestrained sexual desire.
example_en: His unrestrained sexual desire drew everyone's criticism.

definition: the cardinal number thirty five; 35.

definition: the act of reducing, abridging.

example_en: No one found that liar's words believable.

definition: a flowing in a stream.

example_en: The doctor told the patient to take the shankhavataka pill twice a day.

definition: any of several bony fishes of Anguilliformes order, with long, slippery, snake-like bodies and no pelvic fins.

definition: to grind (food) with the molar teeth.

definition: to tear up by the roots; to uproot.
example_en: The storm uprooted the big tree.
